desc:
Welcome to Rocket Ball, where you play soccer in rocket-powered cars! Boost up the walls, fly after a giant ball, and smash it into the goal.

⚽ Bring your friends for 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3 matches!
💥 Ram other cars at full speed and blow them out of your way!
🚀 Practise with unlimited boost, then see if you can score all five shots in Daily Five!
🎨 Choose your wheels and paint, then pick a goal explosion to celebrate with!
🏆 Chase a winning streak and work your way up the leaderboards!

🎮 Play with keyboard and mouse, controller, or touch.

🎁 Join the group to get a free Crew Blocks topper for your car!
